contests.title: City of Palmetto — Ad Valorem Tax Exemption

measures.questionText: Shall persons who are 65 years of age or older by January 1, 2026 and are a resident of Palmetto, Georgia who own and occupy as a primary residence a home situated in the City of Palmetto qualify for 100% of city ad valorem tax exemption in accordance with O.C.G.A. § 48-5-48.3?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Provides a 100% exemption from Palmetto city property taxes for residents who are at least 65 by January 1, 2026 and own and occupy a home within the city as their primary residence, in accordance with Georgia Code Section 48-5-48.3.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve the 100% city property tax exemption for residents meeting these conditions.
measureRecords.noMeans: Reject this proposed city property tax exemption.
